events.strFilename: NASCAR Cup Series 2026-11-08 NASCAR Cup Series Championship Race
events.strDescriptionEN: The NASCAR Cup Series season concludes at Homestead-Miami Speedway with the championship on the line. Kyle Larson enters the final stretch of the season with a commanding points advantage, while Denny Hamlin, Christopher Bell and Chase Briscoe remain among his closest challengers. With 267 laps deciding both the race winner and the 2026 Cup Series champion, every stage point and pit stop could prove decisive.
events.strResult: Ryan Blaney won the NASCAR Cup Series Championship Race at Homestead-Miami Speedway after passing Tyler Reddick on the final lap. Kyle Larson, however, secured the 2026 Cup Series championship after clinching the title mathematically at the end of Stage 1. It was Larson’s third Cup championship and his second consecutive title.
